questions.q: How long does Data Factory itself retain pipeline run history?
options: 45 days
Indefinitely, with no limit
7 days
One calendar year
questions.explain: Data Factory only stores pipeline run data for 45 days — anything longer-term requires routing diagnostic logs to Log Analytics.

questions.q: What does a diagnostic setting actually do?
options: Streams a resource's logs to a destination like a Log Analytics workspace
Automatically fixes failed pipeline runs
Deletes old pipeline runs to save storage
Creates a new data factory for testing
questions.explain: A diagnostic setting routes selected log categories (like PipelineRuns and ActivityRuns) to a destination such as Log Analytics, where they're retained and queryable.

questions.q: Why is Resource specific mode preferred over Azure diagnostics mode for the destination table?
options: Azure diagnostics mode dumps everything into one shared table, which can hit Azure's 500-column limit
Resource specific mode is required for any log category to work at all
Azure diagnostics mode is being fully removed from Azure Monitor
There's no real difference between the two modes
questions.explain: Resource specific mode gives each log category its own dedicated table (like ADFPipelineRun), avoiding the column-count ceiling that the shared AzureDiagnostics table can hit.

questions.q: What language do you use to query Data Factory logs once they're in Log Analytics?
options: KQL, the Kusto Query Language
Standard T-SQL only
Python exclusively
Log Analytics data can't be queried, only viewed as a dashboard
questions.explain: Log Analytics data is queried with KQL, letting you write real queries against tables like ADFPipelineRun and ADFActivityRun.

questions.q: Why do the example queries filter out FailureType != 'UserError'?
options: To exclude failures caused by pipeline configuration, surfacing genuine system-level reliability issues instead
UserError failures can't actually be logged by Data Factory
It's required syntax with no functional purpose
To only show failures triggered manually rather than by a schedule
questions.explain: Filtering out UserError failures focuses the query on system-level reliability trends rather than being skewed by your own configuration mistakes.
